sections.heading: A Super Flexible Kanban Board Component
sections.body_html: Visualize and manage your work with the Bryntum Task Board. Built using modern JavaScript, our Kanban component easily integrates with React, Angular, and Vue applications.
sections.body_text: Visualize and manage your work with the Bryntum Task Board. Built using modern JavaScript, our Kanban component easily integrates with React , Angular , and Vue applications.

sections.heading: Get All the Right Features
sections.body_html:
The Bryntum Task Board includes a set of optional features thoughtfully designed to fit your workflow:

  • Customize the rendering and styling of cards, columns and swimlanes.
  • Toggle features on or off at runtime via a flexible API.
  • Scroll smoothly through massive data sets.

sections.heading: Organize Tasks Into Swimlanes and Columns
sections.body_html:
Part of a busy team? Stay on top of tasks with ease by tailoring your Task Board with swimlanes and any number of columns.

  • Lock an important column in place for quick access.
  • Hide less important tasks by collapsing swimlanes and columns.
  • Filter and sort tasks to focus on your highest priorities.

sections.heading: Fully Customize Your Component
sections.body_html:
Get creative with the many ways you can style the Task Board:

  • Choose from five built-in themes or create your own using CSS variables.
  • Display custom text or markup in cards using the taskRenderer method.
  • Configure which elements appear on each card using the bodyItems.
  • Easily render icons, tags, images, and progress bars.

sections.heading: Benefit From Instantly Familiar UX
sections.body_html:
Reduce your users’ admin load with the Task Board’s inviting and intuitive interactions:

  • Verify changes with confirmation dialogs
  • Auto-scroll to any swimlane or column for easy navigation.
  • Edit tasks directly with inline editing, or use the task editor and context menu options.
